# Biztrait Market

> The unified digital marketplace for software, APIs, hosting, AI services, automation tools, and creator solutions — everything businesses, developers, and creators need in one trusted place.

Biztrait Market helps businesses, developers, marketers, creators, and agencies discover, compare, and purchase premium digital products. Products span software, APIs, hosting, AI services, automation workflows, marketing tools, creator platforms, integrations, and developer utilities. Every product is verified, versioned, rated by real customers, and includes lifetime updates.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Biztrait Market, featured products, and top categories.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Featured products, best sellers, trending, top rated, and recently updated tools.
- [Tools](/tools): Searchable directory of every product on Biztrait Market.
- [Categories](/categories): Browse products by category — software, APIs, hosting, AI, automation, creator, and more.
- [Integrations](/integrations): Native connectors to popular platforms and services.
- [Documentation](/docs): API reference, SDKs, and integration guides.
- [Contact](/contact): Sales, support, and partnership inquiries.
- [HTML Sitemap](/sitemap): Complete page index for humans and crawlers.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Biztrait Market handles customer data.
